Relays product-discovery GET /categories unchanged: the category tree with purchasable counts, shaped \{version, categories: [\{categoryId, parentId (null on a root), name, path, purchasableCount\}]\}. It takes no parameters; anything in the query string is dropped. The page uses it to show department names for the categoryId filter of GET /products. The tree is one bounded navigation document, not a resource collection.
